g.title: ticket_routing
g.text: From a git host event to a workflow

g.title: api
g.text: rejects repeats of the same delivery id

g.title: router
g.text: stored in Temporal, decides with fixed rules

g.title: prev
g.text: a review that requests changes, or
/fix in a comment, on a pull request
(the factory checks it is its own)

g.title: qacmd
g.text: on a feature or bug ticket,
or on the factory's pull request

g.title: updcmd
g.text: /update on a feature or bug ticket,
or on the factory's pull request
merges the base branch into it

g.title: retry
g.text: starts the run again, like reopening
(a notice if one is still running)

g.title: ignored
g.text: other pull request events · factory's own comments
tickets with none of the factory labels

g.title: none
g.text: reply once: close and reopen to run again

g.title: til1
g.text: agent (a role file in a sandbox)

g.title: til3
g.text: deterministic check the factory runs itself
